b: In my late 20s, $250k in hysa (multiple accounts). Have been told to invest in the market but I’m very risk adverse. I don’t have anyone to rely on but myself. Took me a very long time to save this amount and made many lifestyle sacrifices. I will also need to take care of my mother when she gets older (no retirement account). I prefer to have a peace of mind. Interest income is not a lot but it’s enough to pay for groceries and misc expenses. Goal is to have enough saved up to live off interest and never touch principal.

I work both a full time job and part time job. My part time job (very easy) covers rent and I can save 100% of my full time job salary. I also started maxing out my 401k & Roth IRA (Target date fund, ~$35k/year including match). I’m just an average person, not a high earner. I don’t want to stress about money. Recently, I’ve been promoted and got a 10% raise but honestly burned out since I have been taking on 20% more work due to understaffing and increasing projects that the company is taking on. It’s been affecting my mental health as I can’t keep up with the deadlines and have very little downtime to socialize at work nor have time to learn new software. I’m here in NYC since wages are higher, I can save more and don’t need a car to get to work but I hate it here…
